{{Quote|Great Hurrungat<br />The breezes cry for our lands<br />Crushed beneath the Tyrant's fist|An excerpt from ''[[The Twilight Chant]]'', part of Kashoonara folklore|<ref name="Creatures of the Galaxy">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>}}
The '''Tyrant''' was a figure in [[Kashoonara]] folklore. They exhorted [[Hurrungat]] to free them from the Tyrant.
